checklist_items.1.1: On first open the add dialog shows the DeepSeek preset, an empty name, the base URL https://api.deepseek.com, the model deepseek-v4-flash, and an empty upstream-key password field. The preset, name, base URL, model, and upstream key are required. The name, base URL, and model have no maximum length. There are four text fields and no spinbutton. The set-as-default switch is visible, checked, and not required. The create body carries name, preset, base_url, api_key, model, and is_default. The independent GET persists name, preset, base_url, model, and is_default, and it does not return the upstream key.
checklist_items.1.10: covered: A real 502 keeps the add dialog and the name, URL, model, key and default switch, shows the server reason, stores no service, and the retry 201 is the only stored service on the independent GET
checklist_items.1.11: covered: Cancel, close and Escape each close the add dialog immediately, with no unsaved-changes prompt and no AI config write, so the stored services stay unchanged
checklist_items.1.7: Create a service with the minimum required fields through the real modal
checklist_items.1.8: The add dialog's set-as-default control is one switch and it is not a small switch. It starts checked. The first create leaves that switch on. That POST carries the typed name, the typed base URL, the typed model, and is_default true. The independent GET stores that name, preset custom, that base URL, that model, and is_default true, and it does not return the key. A second create, while that row exists, turns the switch off. That POST carries a second typed name, preset custom, the typed base URL, the typed model, and is_default false. The independent GET stores is_default false for the second name, and the first row stays is_default true. After reload the second row shows no default tag and the first row shows the default label. A later POST, while the first row still exists, carries a third typed name, preset custom, the typed base URL, and the typed model, and omits is_default. The independent GET stores is_default false for that third name, and the first row stays is_default true. Deleting the second row leaves the first row as the only default. Deleting the third row leaves that same first row. Deleting that row leaves the independent GET empty.
checklist_items.1.9: covered: While the create POST is held a second click and Enter send no further create, and the later 201 is the only stored service
checklist_items.1.14: Refresh and independent GET preserve the non-secret configuration
checklist_items.1.15: Tab from the name field reaches the base URL, the model, and the upstream key. Add can be focused. Enter on an empty name shows the name-required error, marks the name field invalid, and sends no create. Enter on the filled name sends no POST to /api/v1/ai/configs, leaves the dialog open, and keeps the name. At 1440×900 the name, base URL, model, upstream key, Add, and Cancel each stay inside the viewport, and the name and the key do not overlap Add or Cancel.
checklist_items.7.3: N/A: the upstream key is supplied by the user, not a one-time credential issued by the platform
checklist_items.7.6: The upstream key is absent from config GET and the saved page; acquired fixture/node credentials are registered for failure-artifact redaction
checklist_items.12.1: covered: Add on the AI Services card opens the dialog named Add AI Service
checklist_items.12.2: covered: Add dialog at 1440x900: the dialog and footer Add stay inside the viewport, and the title, body and footer sit inside the dialog without overlap
checklist_items.12.3: covered: Default focus is inside the add dialog. Tab and Shift+Tab each cycle across at least two controls and never leave the dialog
checklist_items.12.4: covered: Cancel, Escape, close and mask each return focus to the Add button on the AI Services card and send no AI config write
checklist_items.12.5: N/A: the add AI service dialog has no nested child layer
checklist_items.12.6: covered: While the create POST is held the footer Add shows the loading state and a second click sends no further create request; the 502 keeps the name, custom preset, URL, model, key and default switch and shows the server reason; the later 201 matches the independent config GET and the reloaded row
checklist_items.12.7: MISSING: the delete Popconfirm has only the title 'Delete this configuration?' and shows neither the configuration name nor an impact description
checklist_items.12.8: N/A: the add AI service dialog has no delete preview, revision, or compare-and-swap
checklist_items.23.1: Without a service the assistant states that one must be configured while Settings stays usable; with a service the tool loop runs
checklist_items.23.2: Question, streaming answer, stop, upstream cancellation and final state are exercised
checklist_items.23.3: The tool result matches an independent inventory read, carries the requested call ID, and error/unavailable content is not reported as success
checklist_items.23.4: The assistant cannot write, and a caller asking it to cannot get around that. call_api's schema carries only path, query, jq and limit - there is no method field - and the reader it is handed exposes Get alone, so a write has no expression at all. A scripted call that does ask for one, sending method DELETE with a labels body to /api/v1/nodes-labels-probe, is echoed by the tool and then fails as a read ('no GET endpoint ...'), and an independent node GET afterwards still shows empty labels. Reading is denied separately: /api/v1/ssh-key and /api/v1/terminal/sessions are refused as routes the assistant may not read, no key material appears in the answer, and a later node GET is unchanged. Removing the Readable guard makes the denied route readable and the case fails.
checklist_items.1.3: covered: each required text field on the add dialog is given a whitespace-only value while the other two carry valid ones, submitted, and required to show its own message - so the rejection is located at the field rather than reported generically, and no POST/PUT/PATCH is observed for any of the three. Proven by mutation: removing whitespace:true from the name rule makes the run fail waiting for 'Enter a name'. Verified under en and zh.
checklist_items.7.1: The upstream key is the only credential the AI service form carries, and its contract is asserted per field rule. It is a password input, so the typed value is never rendered as text, and the saved key is asserted not to appear anywhere in the settings page after creation. On create it is required: an empty value and a whitespace-only value each leave the dialog open, show the product's keyRequired message, mark the field aria-invalid, and the case asserts that pressing Enter on the field in that state sends no POST. The field is then filled and asserted to hold exactly what was typed before the create continues.
checklist_items.7.2: An edit that leaves the upstream key blank means keep the stored key, not clear it. The case opens the created config through the row's edit button, asserts the edit dialog is the editService one, asserts the key field is empty and the name is prefilled, and asserts that pressing Enter in the blank key field submits nothing. Saving is captured as a PATCH and the recorded body is required to contain no api_key at all - so the omission, not an empty string, is what the contract is. A subsequent independent GET is required to return the same config id and to carry no trace of the key, which shows the edit updated the row rather than replacing it. Proven by mutation: making the edit always send api_key fails with the submitted field list.
